age_limit.details: 35 years as on the closing date of the application.

how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official notification PDF.
Fill up the application form completely and prepare your C.V.
Gather photocopies of all relevant documents with self-attestation.
Write “Application for the post of Project Associate I under the project ANRF/ARG/2025/011655/ENS” on the top of the envelope.

Send the hard copy of the filled-up application, C.V., and documents by post to Dr. Ganesh Prasad, Assistant Professor, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, National Institute of Technology Silchar, Silchar–788010, Assam, India.
Send the soft copy of the duly filled application along with C.V. & all necessary documents to the PI through email at [email protected].
Ensure the email subject is “Application for the post of JRF under the project ANRF/ARG/2025/011655/ENS”.
Complete submissions on or before the last date of 23.10.2026.
important_instructions: Employed candidates are to submit a no objection certificate from his/her employer at the time of interview. The Institute has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates to be called for the interview on the basis of screening. No candidate may be recruited if suitable candidates are not found. Selected candidates shall have to sign an agreement at the time of joining. Ensure correct subject lines are used for postal envelopes and emails as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a temporary recruitment notification issued by NIT Silchar to hire 02 Project Associate-I posts under an ANRF-ARG sponsored project in the ECE Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There are a total of 02 vacancies available for the Project Associate-I post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date of receiving/submission of filled up application form is 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum B.Tech/B.E. in ECE/CSE/EE/E&I from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the closing date of the application, with relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD candidates as per Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: GATE/NET qualified candidates will receive INR 37,000/- per month, while others will receive INR 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NIT Silchar Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit hard copies of their filled application, C.V., and self-attested documents to the PI by post and also email a soft copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview date and mode (online/offline) with other details will be duly notified through email.

faq.question: Q10. Who is the Principal Investigator for the project?
faq.answer: Dr. Ganesh Prasad is the Principal Investigator (PI) and Dr. Wasim Arif is the Co-Principal Investigator (Co-PI).
